research_decision.position: DO NOT APPROVE proposed terms. CONDITIONAL DESKTOP DILIGENCE ONLY.
research_decision.why: Current 5% warrants fall short of target IRR even upside; downside FCCR is below 1.20x; NFS finances, ownership, financing need unverified
research_decision.possible_response: Explore a 10% warrant as a negotiation sensitivity only if diligence confirms business fundamentals and downside coverage protections are redesigned; not an approved term sheet.

diligence_questions.evidence_needed: Three audited / reviewed income statements, balance sheets and cash flows
Monthly EBITDA bridges, adjustments, owner expense, recognized revenue

diligence_questions.evidence_needed: Existing senior agreements, collateral, liens and intercreditor consent
Founder and management cap table, incentives, option rights
Customer-level revenue, pricing, terms, renewals and commitments
Actual volumes per plant, throughput vs capacity, revenue per completed unit
diligence_questions.rationale: 25,000 is Ohio capacity, not realized volume

diligence_questions.evidence_needed: OEM allocations, lead times, shipment schedules and cancellation history
Defect, rework, field service, recalls, warranty reserves and claims
diligence_questions.rationale: Industry product safety and liability exposure

diligence_questions.evidence_needed: Plant staffing, overtime, throughput, productivity and skilled labor turnover
Detailed funded capex budget, milestone plan, vendor bids and expected ROI
A/R aging, inventory turns, prepaid OEM materials and payables
Product liability policies, excess coverage, claims and legal disputes
Entity structure, tax deductibility of debt, state registrations and permits

diligence_questions.rationale: Exit at assumed multiple is unverified
